against.learn: A dip on light volume is profit-taking; a dip on heavy volume is selling.

against.head: Distribution
against.text: In five weeks it had 1 up day and 6 down days on volume above both the day before and its average.
against.learn: Up days on heavy volume mean institutions are buying; heavy down days (distribution) mean they are selling.

against.head: Uptrend structure broken, then reclaimed
against.text: On Nov 20 it closed under the Nov 6 higher low, ending the run of higher lows, and it has closed back over that low since; the larger swings (4 ATR) show a lower high.
against.learn: An uptrend steps up in higher highs and higher lows; a lower high is the first warning, and losing the last higher low breaks it.

material.head: QQQ: below its 200-day
material.text: QQQ, the fund it follows, is below its 200-day average.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

material.head: Uptrend on every average
material.text: Price is above its rising 50-day and 200-day averages, and the 50-day is above the 200-day.
material.learn: Both averages rising with price over them: the long trend points up.

material.head: Weekly chart: advancing
material.text: Price is above a rising 30-week average: the advancing stage.
material.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

material.head: Support −1.1% below
material.text: The nearest floor is −1.1% below (0.9 ATR), where 3 levels (2 kinds) meet: the Jul 7 low, the average price paid since the Sep 16 low and the Nov 6 low.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.

material.head: In an 8-week base
material.text: It has moved sideways for 8 weeks in a range 6% deep after a +37% advance.
material.learn: A sideways range after a move, where the stock rests before its next leg.

standouts.head: MACD positive
standouts.text: MACD is above its signal line and above zero, with the histogram rising.
standouts.learn: The gap between a fast and a slow average of price; a cross up through its signal says momentum is turning.

against.head: A lower high and a lower low
against.text: Its last swing high and swing low each came in under the one before.
against.learn: Falling swing highs and lows are the steps of a downtrend.

against.head: A possible double top
against.text: It topped twice at one level (Sep 11 and Oct 30); a close below the low between them confirms the double top.
against.learn: Two highs at one price with a low between; the pattern counts once price closes under that low.

material.head: Broke out of a 3-week base
material.text: On Nov 27 it closed above the base's top (11% deep), on 0.5x average volume, lighter than a strong breakout carries. The break session closed 0.7 ATR past the line on a 0.8-ATR range.
material.learn: A close above a ceiling that capped price before; strongest on heavy volume.

material.head: Buyers stepping in earlier (weekly)
material.text: Weekly: a higher low in price (the week of Nov 2) against a lower low in momentum (4 of 7 gauges): hidden bullish divergence.
material.learn: Higher price lows while momentum sets lower lows: buyers stepped in earlier, a common sign the uptrend resumes.

material.head: Support −3.5% below
material.text: The nearest floor is −3.5% below (1.5 ATR), where 10 levels (3 kinds) meet: the January breakout level, the 50-day average and the 61.8% retracement of the Oct 30–Nov 3 drop.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.
